theme_strategy.concept: Império Da Cana - Modern Artisanal Brazilian Pastelaria & Caldo de Cana POS & Operations Platform
theme_strategy.palette_identity: Cane Green (#16a34a) & Pure Warm Gold (#facc15) accented with artisanal Brazilian warmth (amber crisp pastry, sugar cane fresh green, slate stone)
theme_strategy.aesthetic_fusion: Precision POS Speed Grid + Artisanal Brazilian Pastelaria warmth + Tactical Touch Affordances

entry_surfaces./: split branded authentication & entry dashboard — left artisanal showcase banner with cane gold branding, right role-aware login & quick switch selector
entry_surfaces./login: split branded authentication — left deep green & cane gold brand illustration panel, right elevated credentials form with DEV/ADMIN/ATENDENTE quick fill tabs
entry_surfaces./dashboard: operational command deck — top KPI metric cards with gold/green badges, middle interactive live sales trend & quick actions, bottom recent orders feed
entry_surfaces./mesas: tactical visual table grid with live timer, status filter pills, and quick comanda drawer for instant waiter interaction
entry_surfaces./novo-pedido: high-speed dual-pane POS terminal — left category tabs and responsive product card grid, right sticky live comanda cart with instant checkout & receipt trigger

layout_and_grids.viewport_strategy: Tablet-First POS (768px - 1024px) optimized for fingers/touch target sizes (min 44px tap targets) + responsive desktop and mobile drawers
layout_and_grids.topbar: Fixed 64px header: Logo icon + 'Império Da Cana' + Establishment subtitle + Quick Stat/Shift indicator + User avatar & Role badge (DEV/ADMIN/ATENDENTE in distinctive colors) + Light/Dark theme toggle + Help '?' quick guide trigger + Logout button
layout_and_grids.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar (240px expanded, 72px icon-only, slide-over sheet on mobile/tablet portrait). Navigation items with active pill indicator: Dashboard, Mesas, Novo Pedido, Pedidos, Caixa, Produtos, Funcionários, Relatórios, Configurações, Usuários, Logs
layout_and_grids.mesas_grid: Auto-fit responsive grid (`grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 md:gap-6`). Each mesa card has top status pill, number in large bold display, seated elapsed timer, current total (R$), and quick actions (Abrir Comanda, Ver Detalhes, Liberar)
layout_and_grids.novo_pedido_layout: 2-Column Split POS layout: Left column (60-65% width) with sticky horizontal category tabs (Pasteis Salgados, Pasteis Doces, Caldo de Cana, Combos, Bebidas, Adicionais), search bar, and 2-3 column product cards with image, price, and instant (+) (-) buttons. Right column (35-40% width) sticky comanda order summary cart with mesa/client selector, item list with notes, subtotal, discount, total, and primary action 'Finalizar & Imprimir Comanda'
layout_and_grids.comanda_receipt_modal: Artisanal thermal print preview card (#fefce8 warm paper with jagged edge CSS border or mono dashed lines), showing establishment header, CNPJ, Date/Time, Comanda #, Table #, Itemized table with quantity and unit price, payment method, change/troco, and browser `window.print()` friendly styling

components_strategy.ui_primitives: Shadcn on @base-ui/react located in @/components/ui/ (button, card, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, label, select, sheet, sonner, table, tabs, badge)

custom_domain_components.name: Topbar
custom_domain_components.purpose: Global operational header with status indicator, role badge, theme toggle, help modal button, and quick cashier summary

custom_domain_components.name: Sidebar
custom_domain_components.purpose: Role-filtered dynamic sidebar with active state highlight, collapsed touch mode, and quick shortcut badges

custom_domain_components.name: MesaCard
custom_domain_components.purpose: Interactive table card with status glow border, status badge, elapsed time, live comanda total, and action dropdown

custom_domain_components.name: PosProductCard
custom_domain_components.purpose: Touch-friendly product card with thumbnail, category badge, large price tag, and tap-to-add animation

custom_domain_components.name: PosCartDrawer

custom_domain_components.name: PaymentModal

custom_domain_components.purpose: Interactive help modal explaining keyboard shortcuts (F2 Novo Pedido, F4 Mesas, F8 Caixa), role permissions, and workflow tips

custom_domain_components.name: RoleGuard
custom_domain_components.purpose: Permission boundary wrapping restricted sections (DEV has all access, ADMIN has operational+management, ATENDENTE has POS+Mesas+Pedidos)

rules: Subtle micro-feedback on touch: buttons use active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-100
Cart item insertion uses staggered slide-in and scale animation
Table status change displays a brief glowing pulse animation in the matching status color
Never use universal 'transition: all'; specify transition-colors or transition-transform
Thermal receipt modal animates like a paper feed coming out of a POS register

pastel_assortment.description: Crispy golden fried Brazilian pastéis on a service tray

rules: All text on brand green (#16a34a) must use crisp pure white (#ffffff) or deep forest dark (#064e3b) backgrounds for minimum 4.5:1 ratio
All text on secondary gold (#facc15) must use slate-900 / dark brown (#1e293b / #713f12) - never light text on gold
Table status cards use both distinctive border colors AND text status badges so color-blind operators can differentiate (Livre, Ocupada, Reservada, Manutenção)
All form inputs and buttons have visible focus rings with `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500`

All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and status cards MUST have unambiguous `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="mesa-card-1"`, `data-testid="btn-add-pastel-carne"`, `data-testid="pos-cart-total"`)

key_deliverables: 1. Update `frontend/src/index.css` with the font imports (@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, dm-sans, jetbrains-mono) and Tailwind v4 theme variables.
2. Implement persistent Light/Dark theme provider with next-themes or state synced with localStorage.

3. Seed rich realistic data in `backend/seed.py`: 12+ tables with different states, 25+ authentic menu items (Pastel de Carne, Pastel de Queijo, Pastel Especial da Casa, Caldo de Cana Puro 500ml/1L, Caldo de Cana com Limão, Caldo de Cana com Abacaxi, Caldo de Cana com Gengibre, Combos Imperador, Coxinha, etc.), 3 role accounts (dev@imperio.com / admin@imperio.com / atendente@imperio.com with password '123456'), orders history, cash register transactions, and audit logs.
4. Build the complete role-aware navigation and layout with topbar (shop title, user badge, theme toggle, quick guide modal button, logout) and collapsible sidebar.
5. Build 'Mesas' screen with 4 status colors (Livre=green, Ocupada=red, Reservada=yellow, Manutenção=gray) + status filter pills + instant action modal to open comanda or transfer table.
6. Build 'Novo Pedido' POS terminal with category tabs, search, item custom notes, side live cart, subtotal/tax/discount, and Comanda Print modal.
7. Build 'Pedidos' list with search, status filters, comanda viewer, and Payment Modal with instant troco (change) calculator.
8. Build 'Caixa' (Cash register) with opening/closing balance, sangria (cash-out), suprimento (cash-in), and current cash breakdown.
9. Build 'Relatórios' with Recharts (Sales by hour, Top 5 selling pastéis, Payment methods breakdown, Daily revenue) + CSV export.
10. Build 'Configurações do Sistema' with live Comanda receipt header/footer mask preview, establishment name, CNPJ, and primary color pickers.
11. Build 'Funcionários', 'Produtos' (with image preview, stock & category), 'Usuários', 'Logs de Atividade', and 'Guia Rápido' (?) modal.
12. Ensure all interactive and key metrics elements have `data-testid` attributes for automated testing.
